# SoraSeparator

A horizontal or vertical dividing line, optionally with a centred label.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | display |
| Import | `import { SoraSeparator } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraSeparator from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraSeparator'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/display/SoraSeparator.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/display/SoraSeparator.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `SoraOrientation` | `'horizontal'` | Layout direction. |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | `true` | Decorative separators are hidden from assistive technology. Set to `false` when the line marks a real boundary between groups of content. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` |  | Optional text in the middle of a horizontal separator. |

## Attributes

The root `<div>`.

## Accessibility

- Decorative by default (`role="none"`).
- `decorative=false` renders `role="separator"` with `aria-orientation`.

## Styling

- `.sora-separator`, `.sora-separator__label`
- `data-orientation`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid gap-3">
  <SoraSeparator />
  <SoraSeparator>{{ t('demo.or') }}</SoraSeparator>
  <div class="flex h-6 items-center gap-3 text-sora-sm">
    <span>{{ t('demo.name') }}</span>
    <SoraSeparator orientation="vertical" :decorative="false" />
    <span>{{ t('demo.email') }}</span>
  </div>
</div>
```
